integrity: The proof derives the fixed-subgroup order from the cokernel presentation of phi-I, reduces the p^2 condition to exact p-adic valuation constraints, and counts all valuation and cancellation patterns. The packaged checker independently enumerates automorphism matrices in representative cases and directly checks fixed points in small groups.
scientific_limitations: The exponent gap is required to satisfy b-a >= 2.
The already published pair (a,b)=(1,3) is explicitly excluded from the new theorem.
Adjacent exponents b=a+1 are not covered.
The result counts only automorphisms with exactly p^2 fixed points, not the full theta table.
title: Exactly \(p^2\) fixed points for separated rank-two abelian \(p\)-groups
